lede: Indianapolis Colts carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#12 in EPA per play), while Houston Texans owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#3 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Indianapolis Colts -1.8 with a fair total of 44.8 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Indianapolis Colts pass offence vs Houston Texans pass defence, which sits −0.182 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
